subject.title: [Feature]: Support for sandbox Docker parameters (--gpus all, --ipc=host)

question: Should OpenClaw expose host IPC for Docker sandboxes, and if yes should it be a narrow explicit `sandbox.docker.ipc` break-glass field instead of raw Docker argument passthrough?
rationale: The remaining request changes the sandbox isolation boundary and public config contract; source and release evidence already cover GPU passthrough, but not host IPC.

options.title: Add narrow IPC break-glass field
options.body: Expose an explicit audited IPC setting with schema, config resolution, Docker create args, docs, security audit coverage, config hashing, and tests while keeping raw Docker args unsupported.

options.title: Reject host IPC in core
options.body: Keep GPU passthrough as the supported high-power Docker path and document host IPC as unsupported because it weakens sandbox isolation.

options.title: Define broader namespace policy first
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers settle a consistent policy for IPC, PID, network namespace joins, capabilities, and related dangerous Docker options.

recommendation.title: Add narrow IPC break-glass field
recommendation.body: Expose an explicit audited IPC setting with schema, config resolution, Docker create args, docs, security audit coverage, config hashing, and tests while keeping raw Docker args unsupported.

likelyOwner.reason: The namespace-join hardening history makes steipete the strongest individual routing signal for this sandbox isolation decision.
